The 3-Week Pure'n'Plate Certification Path

Why 3 weeks? Neighbors want to know that food entering their homes is safe, allergen-conscious, and prepared in clean environments. Here is how we verify every kitchen step-by-step:

Week 1
📋

Safety & Knowledge Exam

Online & Self-Paced

Verify your identity and demonstrate core food safety principles based on ServSafe guidelines.

  • ✓ Government ID & Background Check
  • ✓ Pure'n'Plate Food Safety Test (90%+ pass mark on food danger zone, safe cooking temps & cross-contamination)
  • ✓ Kitchen photos & refrigerator thermometer verification (<40°F)

🔍

Live video walkthrough of your kitchen and sending a test dish to a Pure'n'Plate safety inspector.

  • ✓ Cold-chain temperature verification and food packaging audit
  • ✓ Sensory and quality sample submission to our local University City tasting depot
Unlocks automatically after passing Week 1

Frequently Asked Questions for Home Cooks

Do I need a commercial kitchen to sell?

No! Pure'n'Plate operates under Pennsylvania Cottage Food / Home Kitchen sharing guidelines. As long as your kitchen passes our 3-week hygiene and storage inspection, you are certified to cook.

How do payments and payouts work?

Neighbors pay securely through Pure'n'Plate. After pickup is completed, your earnings are automatically deposited every Monday directly into your bank account with zero hidden fees.

What if a customer cancels or doesn't pick up?

Orders are paid in advance! If a neighbor doesn't pick up within the scheduled window, you still receive 100% of the meal payout.

How much time does the 3-week test take?

The online quiz in Week 1 takes 15 minutes. The video walkthrough in Week 2 takes 30 minutes. In Week 3, you simply prepare a 5-portion meal when you are free!

Our Comprehensive Food Safety Policy

✅ Hypothesis Verified: You clicked the Food Safety Policy link! This was recorded in our MVP validation counter. +1 Recorded

1. Mandatory 3-Week Cook Vetting & Background Checks

No cook is ever allowed on Pure'n'Plate without completing identity verification, kitchen video inspection, and a 5-portion community tasting trial.

2. ServSafe Compliant Kitchen Standards

All active sellers must maintain refrigerator logs below 40°F, use separate cutting boards for proteins and produce, and adhere to strict allergen cross-contact prevention.

3. Tamper-Evident Packaging & Temperature Seals

Dishes are sealed with our tamper-evident stickers and packed in eco-friendly insulated packaging with thermal hold time labels.

4. 100% Pure Taste or Money-Back Guarantee

If anything about your meal does not meet total freshness and hygiene standards, we refund 100% immediately, no questions asked.
